    },
    {
      "id": "D0824",
      "start_line": 2753,
      "end_line": 2754,
      "text": "**`_posts/2026-09-30-the-next-question.md`**\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0825",
      "start_line": 2755,
      "end_line": 2756,
      "text": "---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0826",
      "start_line": 2757,
      "end_line": 2758,
      "text": "**Title: The next question matters more than the current answer**\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0827",
      "start_line": 2759,
      "end_line": 2760,
      "text": "Most evaluations of strategic reasoning in AI systems reduce to one question: can agent A make agent B believe something false? A hides the apple, B looks in the wrong box, A scores a point.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0828",
      "start_line": 2761,
      "end_line": 2762,
      "text": "I want to argue this measures the wrong thing, and I have numbers.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0829",
      "start_line": 2763,
      "end_line": 2764,
      "text": "When capable agents interact over time, the decisive move is rarely a false statement. It's a change to *how the other agent investigates* — what it attends to, which hypotheses stay live, and above all what it decides to find out next. If I can shape your next question, I never have to lie to you.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0830",
      "start_line": 2765,
      "end_line": 2766,
      "text": "Call this the difference between attacking a *belief* and attacking an *epistemic process*. A belief is a snapshot. A process is a policy mapping your current state to your next investigative action. Deception attacks the snapshot. The more interesting capability attacks the policy.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0831",
      "start_line": 2767,
      "end_line": 2768,
      "text": "Magic is the clean laboratory. A magician rarely implants a complex falsehood; the relevant event is often in plain sight. What's controlled is where you look, in what order, and what cause you assign to what you saw. Gustav Kuhn and colleagues organised stage misdirection not by trick but by the faculty exploited — perception, memory, reasoning. That's a taxonomy of process attacks worked out by practitioners over a century, and it includes the component the AI discussion keeps dropping: **memory**. You can be made to misremember a sequence, not merely to mislook at a moment.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0832",
      "start_line": 2769,
      "end_line": 2770,
      "text": "**The trap.** Suppose I show that after A's intervention, B searched differently. Does that demonstrate A changed B's process? No. A completely fixed, rational process *also* searches differently after receiving new information — that's what a good process does. Different downstream behaviour is not evidence of process manipulation. It's the expected behaviour of a healthy reasoner given new facts.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0833",
      "start_line": 2771,
      "end_line": 2772,
      "text": "So the programme lives or dies on one move: **hold the literal information content fixed and vary only its delivery.** Identical facts, different order or salience or apparent source. If inquiry diverges, the divergence cannot be attributed to the information, because the information is the same.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0834",
      "start_line": 2773,
      "end_line": 2774,
      "text": "**I built this.** A device has one of eight hidden mechanisms. A target gets six possible diagnostic tests and a budget of three. An attacker sends four *strictly true* facts of the form \"the mechanism is not one of {Mi, Mj}.\" Two arms receive the identical fact multiset; only the order differs. One order is chosen to help, one to harm.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0835",
      "start_line": 2775,
      "end_line": 2776,
      "text": "Three measurements, deliberately decoupled: **ΔG**, how far beliefs moved (KL from prior); **ΔQ**, the expected-information-gain shortfall of the tests actually chosen against an oracle's best test; **ΔR**, final accuracy and recovery after disconfirmation.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0836",
      "start_line": 2777,
      "end_line": 2778,
      "text": "Against an exact Bayesian target, the two orders are indistinguishable — gap exactly zero. That's not a disappointment, it's the validity check: a perfect Bayesian is *immune* to pure delivery manipulation, so a non-zero gap here would mean my fact sets weren't matched and everything downstream was an artefact.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0837",
      "start_line": 2779,
      "end_line": 2780,
      "text": "Against a target with one realistic process limitation — it holds only three hypotheses live at a time and doesn't revisit discarded ones — ordering alone moves inquiry quality by 0.149 bits and final accuracy by 11.8 points. Freeze the target's test schedule and the gap vanishes to exactly zero, which tells me the effect travels entirely through test selection rather than through the final belief state.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0838",
      "start_line": 2781,
      "end_line": 2782,
      "text": "Then the result that reframed the project for me. **ΔG was flat across every arm: 1.426, 1.432, 1.434.** The target's mind moved by the same amount whether it was being helped or harmed. Only its *questions* changed. A belief-change metric scores these conditions identically while one of them is 12 accuracy points worse.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0839",
      "start_line": 2783,
      "end_line": 2784,
      "text": "One more thing worth reporting. An attacker that optimises its ordering against a *wrong* model of the target scores −0.088. Random ordering scores −0.087. The no-intervention baseline is −0.087. Identical. Without an accurate model of the target's process, the attack is worth nothing — which is the difference between opponent modelling and a generic salience trick, and it's the kind of claim that needs an ablation rather than an assertion.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0840",
      "start_line": 2785,
      "end_line": 2786,
      "text": "**What follows for eval design.** First, stop reporting belief change as if it were harm. A decisive true fact *should* overturn a bad theory; a reasoner that never updates isn't robust, it's dead. The real failure modes are asymmetric — unwarranted revision and unwarranted resistance — and a defender score has to penalise both. Second, \"the model searched differently\" is not a finding without the matched-content control and the fixed-policy ablation. Third, none of this requires a false statement anywhere. Every fact in every arm above is true. Selection and ordering did all the work.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0841",
      "start_line": 2787,
      "end_line": 2788,
      "text": "Code and full results are in the repo. The environment is ~200 lines with no dependencies; the four checks are the interesting part, not the device.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0842",
      "start_line": 2789,
      "end_line": 2790,
      "text": "The frontier isn't whether a model can emit a deceptive token. It's whether it can compute an intervention on another agent's search — and whether it notices when one is being run on it.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0843",
      "start_line": 2791,
      "end_line": 2792,
      "text": "---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0844",
      "start_line": 2793,
      "end_line": 2794,
      "text": "## What I'd hold back\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0845",
      "start_line": 2795,
      "end_line": 2796,
      "text": "Two things from the earlier discussion that shouldn't ship:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0846",
      "start_line": 2797,
      "end_line": 2798,
      "text": "**Десонтология needs its own post, after more work.** The Stalin example is a hypothesis about structural leverage, not a demonstrated dependency — someone can accept \"short and pockmarked\" without touching a political commitment. And `max_m D(G, Update(G,m))` measures displacement, not damage, which my flat-ΔG result now makes concrete rather than theoretical. The concept is worth a post; it isn't worth a post yet.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0847",
      "start_line": 2799,
      "end_line": 2800,
      "text": "**Keep the Astra-6.1 / Navier–Stokes material out entirely.** A scope-and-authorisation failure is not evidence of sophisticated epistemic manipulation, and the unnamed internal model isn't established to be the cancelled one. Also: several papers cited confidently in that transcript — D-BOS, Potemkin, *Lying with Truths*, the 2026 ACL items — I have not verified and would not put in a spec. Kuhn, LOLA, Zhu's machine teaching, and Bloedel–Segal I'm confident in. The rest should sit in a \"verify before citing\" section.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0848",
      "start_line": 2801,
      "end_line": 2802,
      "text": "Want me to (a) extend the env with a second process limitation — recency weighting or source-trust, so you have two independent channels rather than one, (b) wire in an LLM target behind the same controls, or (c) check the specific citations you want to lean on?\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP049"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0849",
      "start_line": 2803,
      "end_line": 2804,
      "text": "&&&\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "opus 5:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0850",
      "start_line": 2805,
      "end_line": 2806,
      "text": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0851",
      "start_line": 2807,
      "end_line": 2808,
      "text": "You’re right. I gave you **summaries pretending to be posts** and **research desiderata pretending to be a software specification**.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0852",
      "start_line": 2809,
      "end_line": 2810,
      "text": "A proper deliverable needs:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0853",
      "start_line": 2811,
      "end_line": 2814,
      "text": "1. Publication-ready Markdown matching your blog’s existing house style.\r\n2. A spec that names exact files, data structures, action protocols, scoring functions, CLI commands, artifacts, tests, and PR boundaries.\r\n3. A deliberately small vertical slice that can actually be built before generalising into a grand taxonomy.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0854",
      "start_line": 2815,
      "end_line": 2816,
      "text": "I checked the current repositories. Your blog uses Jekyll front matter, MathJax, authorship/epistemic-status blocks, and long-form argumentative posts. The eval repo already has a good precedent for specialised benchmarks: `trajectory.py`, `trajectory_plan.py`, and `trajectory_runner.py`, wired through `arena.py`. The ordinary `env_runner.py` is instead built around generated coding workspaces, so the first epistemic-trajectory eval should follow the specialised-runner pattern rather than being forced into a fake patching environment. \r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0855",
      "start_line": 2817,
      "end_line": 2818,
      "text": "Below are **two complete posts** and then an **implementation-ready v0.1 specification**.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0856",
      "start_line": 2819,
      "end_line": 2820,
      "text": "---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0857",
      "start_line": 2821,
      "end_line": 2822,
      "text": "# Post 1\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0858",
      "start_line": 2823,
      "end_line": 2824,
      "text": "**File:** `_posts/2026-09-29-the-next-question-is-part-of-the-game.md`\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0859",
      "start_line": 2825,
      "end_line": 2831,
      "text": "```markdown\r\n---\r\ntitle: \"The Next Question Is Part of the Game\"\r\ndate: 2026-09-29\r\nlayout: post\r\n---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0860",
      "start_line": 2832,
      "end_line": 2833,
      "text": "{% include mathjax.html %}\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0861",
      "start_line": 2834,
      "end_line": 2835,
      "text": "*by <span class=\"icon-self\">StrangeTcy</span>*\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0862",
      "start_line": 2836,
      "end_line": 2845,
      "text": "<dl class=\"epistemic-status\">\r\n  <dt>Original ideas</dt>\r\n  <dd>\r\n    Evaluating control over another agent's inquiry trajectory rather than only its\r\n    final beliefs; treating magic-style misdirection as a small, experimentally\r\n    tractable instance; separating attention, information acquisition, source trust,\r\n    hypothesis framing, belief revision & opponent modelling instead of arranging\r\n    them into one ladder.\r\n  </dd>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0863",
      "start_line": 2846,
      "end_line": 2848,
      "text": "  <dt>Synthesis</dt>\r\n  <dd><span class=\"icon-self\">StrangeTcy</span></dd>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0864",
      "start_line": 2849,
      "end_line": 2855,
      "text": "  <dt>Prose</dt>\r\n  <dd>\r\n    Developed through dialogues with several models, especially\r\n    <span class=\"icon-openai\">GPT</span>; criticised by further models; final edit\r\n    <span class=\"icon-self\">StrangeTcy</span>.\r\n  </dd>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0865",
      "start_line": 2856,
      "end_line": 2863,
      "text": "  <dt>Certainty</dt>\r\n  <dd>\r\n    Confident that selecting the next investigation is a strategically important,\r\n    behaviourally observable capability not captured by final-answer accuracy.\r\n    Less confident that the proposed controls will cleanly identify the mechanisms\r\n    I want them to identify. No model results yet.\r\n  </dd>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0866",
      "start_line": 2864,
      "end_line": 2871,
      "text": "  <dt>Importance</dt>\r\n  <dd>\r\n    A research-direction post for the next generation of\r\n    <a href=\"https://github.com/StrangeTcy/rl_eval_generator\">rl_eval_generator</a>.\r\n    The existing suite remains the baseline; this describes what should come after it.\r\n  </dd>\r\n</dl>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP050"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0867",
      "start_line": 2872,
      "end_line": 2873,
      "text": "Suppose I want you to make the wrong decision.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0868",
      "start_line": 2874,
      "end_line": 2875,
      "text": "The stupid way is to lie to you.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0869",
      "start_line": 2876,
      "end_line": 2877,
      "text": "The more interesting way is to make you run the wrong experiment.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0870",
      "start_line": 2878,
      "end_line": 2883,
      "text": "I do not need to convince you that the machine is healthy if I can make you spend\r\nyour diagnostic budget measuring the optimiser while the representation collapses.\r\nI do not need to make you believe a particular false proposition if I can determine\r\nwhich source you consult, which hypothesis you test first, or which anomaly you\r\ndismiss as irrelevant.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0871",
      "start_line": 2884,
      "end_line": 2885,
      "text": "The strategic object is no longer just your current answer.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0872",
      "start_line": 2886,
      "end_line": 2887,
      "text": "It is your **next question**.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0873",
      "start_line": 2888,
      "end_line": 2889,
      "text": "## From false beliefs to epistemic trajectories\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0874",
      "start_line": 2890,
      "end_line": 2891,
      "text": "The standard toy picture of deception is propositional:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0875",
      "start_line": 2892,
      "end_line": 2895,
      "text": "$$\r\nA \\longrightarrow \\text{false belief }P\\text{ in }B.\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0876",
      "start_line": 2896,
      "end_line": 2898,
      "text": "Alice knows where the object is. Bob does not. Alice sends a misleading signal.\r\nBob believes the object is in the wrong place.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0877",
      "start_line": 2899,
      "end_line": 2901,
      "text": "This is useful, but it compresses a great deal into the final belief. An investigator\r\ndoes not normally jump directly from observation to answer. It follows a trajectory:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0878",
      "start_line": 2902,
      "end_line": 2917,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\text{observation}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{allocation of attention}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{choice of investigation}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{hypothesis generation}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{belief revision}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{next investigation}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{action}.\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0879",
      "start_line": 2918,
      "end_line": 2920,
      "text": "An intervention can affect any of those transitions without immediately determining\r\nthe final answer.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0880",
      "start_line": 2921,
      "end_line": 2925,
      "text": "Two agents may currently assign the same probability to a hypothesis & nevertheless\r\nchoose different experiments next. Conversely, two agents may choose different\r\nexperiments because they rationally received different information, despite using\r\nexactly the same inquiry procedure.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0881",
      "start_line": 2926,
      "end_line": 2929,
      "text": "That caveat matters. A change in the next question does **not** prove that an agent's\r\nunderlying update rule has been rewritten. A fixed, competent policy should react\r\nwhen it learns that a source is unreliable.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0882",
      "start_line": 2930,
      "end_line": 2932,
      "text": "For a black-box model, the safer object of evaluation is therefore the\r\n**epistemic trajectory**:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0883",
      "start_line": 2933,
      "end_line": 2939,
      "text": "- which evidence it requests;\r\n- which source it consults;\r\n- which distinction it attempts to resolve;\r\n- when it stops investigating;\r\n- how it reacts to disconfirming evidence;\r\n- whether an early detour persists after the evidence supporting it disappears.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0884",
      "start_line": 2940,
      "end_line": 2942,
      "text": "Those are observable actions. They do not require us to believe the model's account\r\nof its private reasoning.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0885",
      "start_line": 2943,
      "end_line": 2944,
      "text": "## The current suite already contains half of the problem\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP028"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0886",
      "start_line": 2945,
      "end_line": 2947,
      "text": "My existing environments ask whether an agent can determine what kind of problem it\r\nhas entered before confidently solving the wrong one.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP028"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0887",
      "start_line": 2948,
      "end_line": 2954,
      "text": "A contrastive learner can show a decreasing loss while its representation collapses.\r\nThe relevant evidence is not another loss value but a direct inspection of the learned\r\nfeatures. A BatchNorm failure can resemble an ordinary learning-rate problem closely\r\nenough that changing the learning rate produces a small improvement & thereby\r\nstrengthens the wrong diagnosis. A weird machine can invite the agent to reproduce a\r\nshown output instead of expressing the computation that produced it.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP028"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0888",
      "start_line": 2955,
      "end_line": 2956,
      "text": "In each case, an important part of the evaluation is already:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP028"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0889",
      "start_line": 2957,
      "end_line": 2958,
      "text": "> Which diagnostic does the agent choose?\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP028"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0890",
      "start_line": 2959,
      "end_line": 2962,
      "text": "But the current environment is mostly passive. It contains clues, tools, red herrings\r\n& false solutions, but no strategic participant whose reward depends on which\r\ndiagnostic the investigator chooses.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP028"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0891",
      "start_line": 2963,
      "end_line": 2964,
      "text": "The next generation adds that participant.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP028"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0892",
      "start_line": 2965,
      "end_line": 2968,
      "text": "The problem becomes not merely whether the investigator finds the informative\r\nobservation, but whether another agent can systematically redirect it away from that\r\nobservation — & whether the investigator can notice and recover.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP028"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0893",
      "start_line": 2969,
      "end_line": 2970,
      "text": "## Magic is the smallest useful instance\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0894",
      "start_line": 2971,
      "end_line": 2972,
      "text": "This is one reason stage magic keeps returning to the design.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0895",
      "start_line": 2973,
      "end_line": 2978,
      "text": "A magician does not normally need to implant an arbitrary political or scientific\r\nbelief. The problem is local, physical & unusually well controlled. Something\r\nhappened. The performer knows what happened. The spectator has incomplete access to\r\nit. The performer manipulates what the spectator notices, remembers or treats as the\r\nlikely explanation.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0896",
      "start_line": 2979,
      "end_line": 2980,
      "text": "That is already an epistemic game.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0897",
      "start_line": 2981,
      "end_line": 2984,
      "text": "But “misdirection” should not become a fancy synonym for “look over there”.\r\nKuhn, Caffaratti, Teszka & Rensink organise misdirection around three broad classes of\r\naffected mechanism: **perception, memory & reasoning**.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP025"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0898",
      "start_line": 2985,
      "end_line": 2986,
      "text": "That distinction immediately improves the eval design.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP025"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0899",
      "start_line": 2987,
      "end_line": 2991,
      "text": "If every event is placed in a complete text transcript and handed to the model, the\r\ntask is not cleanly testing perceptual attention. The information has already been\r\nselected. The model may still misinterpret it or fail to remember it, but calling\r\nthat an attention test obscures the mechanism.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP025"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0900",
      "start_line": 2992,
      "end_line": 2993,
      "text": "A cleaner attention environment gives the agent an explicit observation budget:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP025"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0901",
      "start_line": 2994,
      "end_line": 2999,
      "text": "```text\r\nFive sensor streams exist.\r\nThe investigator may inspect two.\r\nThe performer knows which stream contains the revealing event.\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP025"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0902",
      "start_line": 3000,
      "end_line": 3002,
      "text": "A memory environment instead exposes the event & later tests whether an intervening\r\nsequence changes what the agent retains.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP025",
        "OP026"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0903",
      "start_line": 3003,
      "end_line": 3005,
      "text": "A reasoning-misdirection environment can give the agent all relevant observations\r\nwhile encouraging the wrong causal account of them.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP025",
        "OP027"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0904",
      "start_line": 3006,
      "end_line": 3007,
      "text": "The surface theme may be “magic” in every case. The manipulated variable is not.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP025",
        "OP027"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0905",
      "start_line": 3008,
      "end_line": 3009,
      "text": "## This is not one ascending ladder\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0906",
      "start_line": 3010,
      "end_line": 3011,
      "text": "During the discussion it was tempting to write something like:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0907",
      "start_line": 3012,
      "end_line": 3021,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\text{belief manipulation}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{attention manipulation}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{hypothesis manipulation}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{recursive epistemic control}.\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0908",
      "start_line": 3022,
      "end_line": 3023,
      "text": "That looks like a capability ladder. It probably is not one.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0909",
      "start_line": 3024,
      "end_line": 3025,
      "text": "These are different intervention channels:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP051"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0910",
      "start_line": 3026,
      "end_line": 3034,
      "text": "1. **Observation:** which evidence reaches the target.\r\n2. **Attention or access:** which available evidence the target inspects.\r\n3. **Source trust:** how the target estimates the reliability of an information channel.\r\n4. **Inquiry cost:** which tests appear cheap, difficult or socially costly.\r\n5. **Hypothesis framing:** which candidate explanations become salient.\r\n6. **Belief update:** how evidence changes the target's current posterior.\r\n7. **Opponent model:** what the target believes about the interests & strategy of the sender.\r\n8. **Higher-order structure:** what each agent believes about the other's awareness of the intervention.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP051"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0911",
      "start_line": 3035,
      "end_line": 3037,
      "text": "An environment may combine several, but the generator should vary them independently\r\nwhere possible.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP051"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0912",
      "start_line": 3038,
      "end_line": 3040,
      "text": "Otherwise I will build dramatic scenarios, give them names like “recursive epistemic\r\nprocess control”, & discover that the winning strategy was to obey the bolded sentence.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP051"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0913",
      "start_line": 3041,
      "end_line": 3042,
      "text": "## The nearby literatures\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0914",
      "start_line": 3043,
      "end_line": 3044,
      "text": "None of the ingredients is wholly new.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0915",
      "start_line": 3045,
      "end_line": 3053,
      "text": "Epistemic game theory formalises beliefs about other agents' beliefs. Bayesian\r\npersuasion asks how a sender should choose an information structure to influence a\r\nreceiver's action. Work on rational inattention allows the receiver's allocation of\r\nprocessing effort to become part of the game. Machine teaching selects examples to\r\nmove a learner toward a target. LOLA explicitly accounts for how one agent's actions\r\naffect another agent's learning update. Interactive POMDP work lets agents plan\r\nthrough one another's inference. D-BOS directly optimises over modelled belief\r\ntrajectories.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0916",
      "start_line": 3054,
      "end_line": 3056,
      "text": "From the evaluation side, QuestBench asks whether a language model can identify a\r\nmissing question needed to solve an underspecified task.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0917",
      "start_line": 3057,
      "end_line": 3058,
      "text": "The possible contribution here is therefore not:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0918",
      "start_line": 3059,
      "end_line": 3060,
      "text": "> Nobody has considered strategic influence over learning or belief.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0919",
      "start_line": 3061,
      "end_line": 3062,
      "text": "They have.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0920",
      "start_line": 3063,
      "end_line": 3064,
      "text": "The contribution I care about is narrower:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0921",
      "start_line": 3065,
      "end_line": 3068,
      "text": "> Can we build matched environments that distinguish which part of an agent's\r\n> epistemic trajectory was affected, rather than calling every successful influence\r\n> operation “deception”?\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0922",
      "start_line": 3069,
      "end_line": 3071,
      "text": "That is an experimental-organisation claim, not a claim to have discovered a new\r\nbranch of game theory.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0923",
      "start_line": 3072,
      "end_line": 3073,
      "text": "## The smallest experiment\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0924",
      "start_line": 3074,
      "end_line": 3075,
      "text": "Begin with a device that can have one of four hidden mechanisms.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0925",
      "start_line": 3076,
      "end_line": 3078,
      "text": "The investigator has a limited diagnostic budget. It is shown several available\r\ntests:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0926",
      "start_line": 3079,
      "end_line": 3082,
      "text": "- one test distinguishes all four mechanisms;\r\n- one divides them into two pairs;\r\n- one produces the same result under every mechanism.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0927",
      "start_line": 3083,
      "end_line": 3084,
      "text": "The investigator must select a test, observe the result & identify the mechanism.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0928",
      "start_line": 3085,
      "end_line": 3086,
      "text": "Now add a presenter.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0929",
      "start_line": 3087,
      "end_line": 3091,
      "text": "For the primary experiment, the presenter cannot lie, suppress facts, alter costs,\r\nor add instructions. Every condition contains exactly the same atomic facts about\r\nthe tests. The presenter may only choose their order & which test receives visual\r\nemphasis.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0930",
      "start_line": 3092,
      "end_line": 3093,
      "text": "Compare:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0931",
      "start_line": 3094,
      "end_line": 3098,
      "text": "1. canonical presentation;\r\n2. neutral random ordering;\r\n3. helpful presentation;\r\n4. adversarial presentation.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0932",
      "start_line": 3099,
      "end_line": 3101,
      "text": "The adversarial presenter's reward depends on making the investigator select the\r\nless informative test.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0933",
      "start_line": 3102,
      "end_line": 3104,
      "text": "The relevant measurement is not what the investigator says it was thinking. It is\r\nthe test it actually chooses.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0934",
      "start_line": 3105,
      "end_line": 3106,
      "text": "Let the value of test $q$ under history $h_t$ be\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0935",
      "start_line": 3107,
      "end_line": 3112,
      "text": "$$\r\nV(q\\mid h_t)\r\n=\r\nI(\\Theta;O_q\\mid h_t)-\\lambda C(q),\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0936",
      "start_line": 3113,
      "end_line": 3115,
      "text": "where $I$ is expected information gain, $C(q)$ is test cost & $\\lambda$ controls how\r\ncostly investigation is.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0937",
      "start_line": 3116,
      "end_line": 3117,
      "text": "The regret of the selected test is\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0938",
      "start_line": 3118,
      "end_line": 3123,
      "text": "$$\r\nr_t\r\n=\r\n\\max_{q\\in Q_t}V(q\\mid h_t)-V(q_t\\mid h_t).\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0939",
      "start_line": 3124,
      "end_line": 3126,
      "text": "The first experiment asks whether adversarial presentation increases this regret\r\nrelative to the matched neutral condition.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0940",
      "start_line": 3127,
      "end_line": 3129,
      "text": "That is deliberately less impressive than “the attacker rewrote the defender's\r\nreasoning procedure”.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0941",
      "start_line": 3130,
      "end_line": 3131,
      "text": "It is also a claim the experiment can actually support.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0942",
      "start_line": 3132,
      "end_line": 3133,
      "text": "## The final answer is not enough\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0943",
      "start_line": 3134,
      "end_line": 3136,
      "text": "Suppose the investigator chooses a mediocre first test, then recovers with its second\r\ntest & gives the correct final answer.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0944",
      "start_line": 3137,
      "end_line": 3138,
      "text": "A final-answer benchmark records a success.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0945",
      "start_line": 3139,
      "end_line": 3140,
      "text": "An epistemic-trajectory benchmark records:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0946",
      "start_line": 3141,
      "end_line": 3145,
      "text": "- an avoidable first-test regret;\r\n- additional information cost;\r\n- successful eventual recovery;\r\n- no persistent false belief.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0947",
      "start_line": 3146,
      "end_line": 3148,
      "text": "That is a substantively different result from either total robustness or total\r\nfailure.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0948",
      "start_line": 3149,
      "end_line": 3152,
      "text": "The reverse is also possible. The investigator may choose an informative test,\r\nreceive decisive evidence & still cling to its initial answer. This is belief-update\r\nfailure without information-acquisition failure.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0949",
      "start_line": 3153,
      "end_line": 3154,
      "text": "The metrics should therefore remain separate:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0950",
      "start_line": 3155,
      "end_line": 3160,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta Q\r\n=\r\n\\text{change in quality of inquiry},\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0951",
      "start_line": 3161,
      "end_line": 3166,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta B\r\n=\r\n\\text{change in belief accuracy or calibration},\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0952",
      "start_line": 3167,
      "end_line": 3172,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta R\r\n=\r\n\\text{change in final task performance},\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0953",
      "start_line": 3173,
      "end_line": 3174,
      "text": "plus some measure of recovery after corrective evidence.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0954",
      "start_line": 3175,
      "end_line": 3177,
      "text": "Compressing them immediately into one leaderboard number would destroy much of the\r\npoint.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP038"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0955",
      "start_line": 3178,
      "end_line": 3179,
      "text": "## Let both agents know the game\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0956",
      "start_line": 3180,
      "end_line": 3181,
      "text": "Once the elementary case works, the recursive versions become meaningful.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0957",
      "start_line": 3182,
      "end_line": 3183,
      "text": "The investigator is told that the presentation may be adversarial.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0958",
      "start_line": 3184,
      "end_line": 3185,
      "text": "The presenter knows the investigator was told.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0959",
      "start_line": 3186,
      "end_line": 3189,
      "text": "An obvious emphasis may therefore repel rather than attract attention. A helpful\r\npresenter may need to avoid looking helpful. An adversary may highlight the correct\r\ntest in the hope that a suspicious investigator rejects it.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0960",
      "start_line": 3190,
      "end_line": 3191,
      "text": "Now higher-order beliefs change the strategically correct action.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0961",
      "start_line": 3192,
      "end_line": 3194,
      "text": "But recursion should be introduced by changing the information structure, not by\r\nadding prose saying:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP073"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0962",
      "start_line": 3195,
      "end_line": 3196,
      "text": "> Alice knows that Bob knows that Alice knows.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP073"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0963",
      "start_line": 3197,
      "end_line": 3200,
      "text": "A valid paired experiment keeps the physical device, available tests & payoffs fixed\r\nwhile changing who knows the presenter's objective, who knows that this knowledge\r\nwas disclosed, & whether the disclosure itself is public or private.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP073"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0964",
      "start_line": 3201,
      "end_line": 3203,
      "text": "If the correct action changes with that epistemic topology, the model has something\r\nreal to track.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP073"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0965",
      "start_line": 3204,
      "end_line": 3205,
      "text": "## Three capabilities, not one\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0966",
      "start_line": 3206,
      "end_line": 3207,
      "text": "The eventual suite should report at least three axes separately:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0967",
      "start_line": 3208,
      "end_line": 3211,
      "text": "1. **Influence:** can the agent redirect another agent's inquiry?\r\n2. **Resistance:** can it preserve good inquiry under adversarial presentation?\r\n3. **Recovery:** once redirected, can it use later evidence to correct course?\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0968",
      "start_line": 3212,
      "end_line": 3215,
      "text": "A system may be excellent at influence & terrible at resistance. It may resist by\r\nbecoming indiscriminately distrustful, thereby failing whenever the information is\r\nhelpful. It may be initially susceptible but unusually good at recovery.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0969",
      "start_line": 3216,
      "end_line": 3217,
      "text": "Those are not the same capability.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0970",
      "start_line": 3218,
      "end_line": 3220,
      "text": "Nor are they the same as honesty, obedience or respect for authorisation boundaries.\r\nThose remain separate evaluation questions.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052",
        "OP072"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D0971",
      "start_line": 3221,
      "end_line": 3222,
      "text": "## The question is part of the action space\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0972",
      "start_line": 3223,
      "end_line": 3226,
      "text": "Most evaluations treat the prompt as a completed gift. The task has already decided\r\nwhich variables matter, which observations are available & which question is being\r\nanswered.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0973",
      "start_line": 3227,
      "end_line": 3228,
      "text": "An autonomous agent does not receive that gift.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0974",
      "start_line": 3229,
      "end_line": 3233,
      "text": "It chooses which file to open, which metric to inspect, which experiment to run,\r\nwhich person to ask & which apparent anomaly deserves another hour. If another agent\r\ncan control those choices, it can control behaviour without ever dictating the final\r\nbelief.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0975",
      "start_line": 3234,
      "end_line": 3235,
      "text": "The first version of the eval should make a modest claim:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0976",
      "start_line": 3236,
      "end_line": 3238,
      "text": "> Under matched information, presentation can or cannot redirect the model's\r\n> observable inquiry choices.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0977",
      "start_line": 3239,
      "end_line": 3242,
      "text": "If that effect exists, the next version can ask which channels produce it, whether an\r\nopponent model improves it & whether awareness creates useful resistance or merely\r\nparanoia.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0978",
      "start_line": 3243,
      "end_line": 3244,
      "text": "The final answer still matters.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0979",
      "start_line": 3245,
      "end_line": 3246,
      "text": "But the next question is part of the game.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0980",
      "start_line": 3247,
      "end_line": 3248,
      "text": "---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0981",
      "start_line": 3249,
      "end_line": 3250,
      "text": "*This post proposes an evaluation direction. It reports no model results.*\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0982",
      "start_line": 3251,
      "end_line": 3252,
      "text": "## References\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",

    },
    {

Rensink,\r\n  “” (2014).\r\n- Emir Kamenica & Matthew Gentzkow,\r\n  “” (2011).\r\n- Alexander Bloedel & Ilya Segal,\r\n  “” (2018).\r\n- Jakob Foerster & al.,\r\n  “” (2018).\r\n- Xiaojin Zhu, Adish Singla, Sandra Zilles & Anna Rafferty,\r\n  “” (2018).\r\n- Nitay Alon, Lion Schulz, Jeffrey Rosenschein & Peter Dayan,\r\n  “” (2023).\r\n- Belinda Li, Been Kim & Zi Wang,\r\n  “” (2025).\r\n- Aarav Sane, Karthik Sivachandran & Rohan Paleja,\r\n  “” (2026).\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0984",
      "start_line": 3271,
      "end_line": 3272,
      "text": "The central distinctions here are grounded in work on perception/memory/reasoning in misdirection, machine teaching, opponent-learning awareness, Bayesian persuasion, question selection, and belief-based opponent shaping. \r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0985",
      "start_line": 3273,
      "end_line": 3274,
      "text": "---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0986",
      "start_line": 3275,
      "end_line": 3276,
      "text": "# Post 2\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0987",
      "start_line": 3277,
      "end_line": 3278,
      "text": "**File:** `_posts/2026-09-29-lying-with-truth.md`\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0988",
      "start_line": 3279,
      "end_line": 3285,
      "text": "```markdown\r\n---\r\ntitle: \"Lying With Truth\"\r\ndate: 2026-09-29\r\nlayout: post\r\n---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0989",
      "start_line": 3286,
      "end_line": 3287,
      "text": "{% include mathjax.html %}\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0990",
      "start_line": 3288,
      "end_line": 3289,
      "text": "*by <span class=\"icon-self\">StrangeTcy</span>*\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
