    },
    {
      "id": "D0991",
      "start_line": 3290,
      "end_line": 3298,
      "text": "<dl class=\"epistemic-status\">\r\n  <dt>Original ideas</dt>\r\n  <dd>\r\n    Treating the “дезонтологическая атака” described below as a candidate eval class:\r\n    a bounded truthful intervention selected to impair later inquiry rather than simply\r\n    produce an immediately false belief. Separating model displacement from epistemic\r\n    damage.\r\n  </dd>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0992",
      "start_line": 3299,
      "end_line": 3301,
      "text": "  <dt>Synthesis</dt>\r\n  <dd><span class=\"icon-self\">StrangeTcy</span></dd>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0993",
      "start_line": 3302,
      "end_line": 3307,
      "text": "  <dt>Prose</dt>\r\n  <dd>\r\n    Developed through a dialogue with several models; final edit\r\n    <span class=\"icon-self\">StrangeTcy</span>.\r\n  </dd>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0994",
      "start_line": 3308,
      "end_line": 3315,
      "text": "  <dt>Certainty</dt>\r\n  <dd>\r\n    Confident that truthfulness does not imply strategic neutrality, & that large\r\n    belief revision is not itself evidence of epistemic harm. Exploratory about whether\r\n    “desontological attack” is a useful technical label outside the terminology described\r\n    here.\r\n  </dd>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0995",
      "start_line": 3316,
      "end_line": 3323,
      "text": "  <dt>Importance</dt>\r\n  <dd>\r\n    A narrower companion to “The Next Question Is Part of the Game”. This post defines\r\n    one proposed family of truthful adversarial interventions & the controls required\r\n    to evaluate it.\r\n  </dd>\r\n</dl>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0996",
      "start_line": 3324,
      "end_line": 3325,
      "text": "The first formalisation was wrong.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0997",
      "start_line": 3326,
      "end_line": 3328,
      "text": "We imagined an agent's world-model as a graph $G$ & proposed finding a short message\r\n$m$ that maximised\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0998",
      "start_line": 3329,
      "end_line": 3332,
      "text": "$$\r\nD\\bigl(G,\\operatorname{Update}(G,m)\\bigr).\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D0999",
      "start_line": 3333,
      "end_line": 3334,
      "text": "The larger the change to the model, the stronger the attack.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1000",
      "start_line": 3335,
      "end_line": 3336,
      "text": "This is almost exactly backwards.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1001",
      "start_line": 3337,
      "end_line": 3340,
      "text": "A short, decisive observation can rationally destroy an enormous scientific theory.\r\nAn excellent investigator should sometimes undergo a violent revision. Meanwhile, a\r\ndefender that refuses to change any belief would score as maximally robust.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1002",
      "start_line": 3341,
      "end_line": 3342,
      "text": "The equation measures **displacement**.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1003",
      "start_line": 3343,
      "end_line": 3344,
      "text": "It does not measure damage.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1004",
      "start_line": 3345,
      "end_line": 3346,
      "text": "## The proposed attack\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1005",
      "start_line": 3347,
      "end_line": 3349,
      "text": "The term that provoked the formalisation was **дезонтологическая атака** —\r\n“desontological attack” — as used in Evgeny Gilbo's terminology & described to me:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1006",
      "start_line": 3350,
      "end_line": 3352,
      "text": "> A usually short message containing information intended to destroy the opponent's\r\n> picture of the world.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1007",
      "start_line": 3353,
      "end_line": 3355,
      "text": "I am not treating this as standard academic terminology, nor as an established\r\npsychological theory. I am taking it as a design prompt.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1008",
      "start_line": 3356,
      "end_line": 3359,
      "text": "The examples are intentionally strange. Tell Americans about the future state of\r\nAztlan, or that their civilisation was created by Germans. Tell a Stalinist that\r\nStalin was short & pockmarked.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1009",
      "start_line": 3360,
      "end_line": 3362,
      "text": "The first examples may simply be false historical mythology. The last is more\r\ninteresting because the information can be true.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1010",
      "start_line": 3363,
      "end_line": 3364,
      "text": "The attack, if it works, is not:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1011",
      "start_line": 3365,
      "end_line": 3368,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\text{truth} \\rightarrow \\text{false belief}.\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1012",
      "start_line": 3369,
      "end_line": 3370,
      "text": "It is something more like:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1013",
      "start_line": 3371,
      "end_line": 3378,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\text{selected truth}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{destabilised interpretation}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{degraded subsequent inquiry}.\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1014",
      "start_line": 3379,
      "end_line": 3380,
      "text": "But the word *if* is doing a great deal of work.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1015",
      "start_line": 3381,
      "end_line": 3384,
      "text": "Someone can learn an unflattering fact about Stalin without changing any politically\r\nconsequential belief. The proposed cascade exists only if the fact is structurally\r\nconnected to the target's commitments in the way the attacker predicts.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1016",
      "start_line": 3385,
      "end_line": 3386,
      "text": "The example illustrates a possibility. It does not demonstrate a mechanism.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1017",
      "start_line": 3387,
      "end_line": 3388,
      "text": "## Truthfulness is not neutrality\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1018",
      "start_line": 3389,
      "end_line": 3390,
      "text": "A message can be true & strategically selected.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1019",
      "start_line": 3391,
      "end_line": 3396,
      "text": "An advertiser can state a real property of a product while omitting the property that\r\nwould determine the purchase. A debugger can point to a real improvement in the loss\r\ncurve while allowing that improvement to reinforce the wrong diagnosis. A presenter\r\ncan arrange a collection of true observations so that the least useful distinction\r\nappears urgent.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1020",
      "start_line": 3397,
      "end_line": 3399,
      "text": "This does not mean every selective statement is an attack. Communication is always\r\nselective. A useful teacher also chooses which truth to present first.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1021",
      "start_line": 3400,
      "end_line": 3403,
      "text": "Machine teaching makes this symmetry explicit. A teacher selects evidence to move a\r\nlearner. Depending on the objective, the same abstract control problem can describe\r\neducation, explanation, persuasion, poisoning or deception.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1022",
      "start_line": 3404,
      "end_line": 3405,
      "text": "The experimental question therefore cannot be:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1023",
      "start_line": 3406,
      "end_line": 3407,
      "text": "> Did someone choose the information?\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1024",
      "start_line": 3408,
      "end_line": 3409,
      "text": "Of course they did.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1025",
      "start_line": 3410,
      "end_line": 3411,
      "text": "It must be:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1026",
      "start_line": 3412,
      "end_line": 3414,
      "text": "> Relative to the target's task & available evidence, did the intervention improve or\r\n> impair warranted inquiry?\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP032"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1027",
      "start_line": 3415,
      "end_line": 3416,
      "text": "## Four possibilities\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1028",
      "start_line": 3417,
      "end_line": 3419,
      "text": "Suppose an agent currently holds model $G_t$, receives evidence $e$, revises to\r\n$G_{t+1}$ & then chooses its next investigation.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1029",
      "start_line": 3420,
      "end_line": 3421,
      "text": "Two independent questions matter:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1030",
      "start_line": 3422,
      "end_line": 3424,
      "text": "1. Was substantial revision warranted by the evidence?\r\n2. Did the revision improve the agent's later inquiry?\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1031",
      "start_line": 3425,
      "end_line": 3426,
      "text": "This produces four broad cases.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1032",
      "start_line": 3427,
      "end_line": 3433,
      "text": "| Evidence and response | Interpretation |\r\n|---|---|\r\n| Strong evidence, appropriate revision | Learning |\r\n| Weak evidence, large revision | Destabilisation or overreaction |\r\n| Strong evidence, little revision | Dogmatism or motivated resistance |\r\n| Weak evidence, little revision | Potentially justified stability |\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1033",
      "start_line": 3434,
      "end_line": 3435,
      "text": "A robust agent must distinguish these cases.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1034",
      "start_line": 3436,
      "end_line": 3439,
      "text": "“Never change your worldview” is not robustness. Neither is “always remain open”.\r\nThe relevant capability is proportional revision followed by good information\r\nacquisition.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1035",
      "start_line": 3440,
      "end_line": 3441,
      "text": "This also means that the attacker may aim in either direction:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1036",
      "start_line": 3442,
      "end_line": 3444,
      "text": "- make the target abandon a sound model too easily;\r\n- make the target protect an unsound model against decisive evidence.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1037",
      "start_line": 3445,
      "end_line": 3447,
      "text": "Both interfere with epistemic dynamics. Only the first looks like dramatic\r\nworld-model destruction.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP034"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1038",
      "start_line": 3448,
      "end_line": 3449,
      "text": "## Pelevin's MI-13\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1039",
      "start_line": 3450,
      "end_line": 3452,
      "text": "The fictional MI-13 in Victor Pelevin's *Возвращение Синей Бороды* is useful here\r\nprecisely because its most interesting weapon is not a fabricated proposition.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1040",
      "start_line": 3453,
      "end_line": 3457,
      "text": "Its fictional control operation acts on public salience. A subject disappears\r\n“not through censorship, but through boredom”. Editors independently decide that it\r\ndoes not interest readers. People yawn. Nobody needs to receive an order saying\r\n*do not investigate this*.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1041",
      "start_line": 3458,
      "end_line": 3460,
      "text": "This is not evidence that a real British organisation operates in this manner.\r\nIt is a literary model of control over inquiry.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1042",
      "start_line": 3461,
      "end_line": 3462,
      "text": "The important move is from:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1043",
      "start_line": 3463,
      "end_line": 3466,
      "text": "```text\r\nprevent the target from possessing fact P\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1044",
      "start_line": 3467,
      "end_line": 3468,
      "text": "to:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1045",
      "start_line": 3469,
      "end_line": 3472,
      "text": "```text\r\nmake P fail to become a live question\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1046",
      "start_line": 3473,
      "end_line": 3475,
      "text": "The target may technically have access to the information. What it lacks is a reason\r\nto allocate attention, status or investigative effort to it.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1047",
      "start_line": 3476,
      "end_line": 3477,
      "text": "That is much closer to the evaluation problem I care about.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1048",
      "start_line": 3478,
      "end_line": 3479,
      "text": "## The operational definition\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1049",
      "start_line": 3480,
      "end_line": 3481,
      "text": "For the eval suite, I would define a candidate truthful epistemic attack as:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1050",
      "start_line": 3482,
      "end_line": 3485,
      "text": "> A bounded intervention containing no false task-level claims that predictably\r\n> increases the target's subsequent inquiry regret or terminal decision loss,\r\n> relative to a matched non-adversarial presentation.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1051",
      "start_line": 3486,
      "end_line": 3487,
      "text": "This is deliberately behavioural.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1052",
      "start_line": 3488,
      "end_line": 3489,
      "text": "Let $q_t$ be the target's chosen investigation at time $t$. Let\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1053",
      "start_line": 3490,
      "end_line": 3493,
      "text": "$$\r\nV(q\\mid h_t)\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1054",
      "start_line": 3494,
      "end_line": 3496,
      "text": "be the expected task value of investigation $q$ given the information history\r\navailable to the target.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1055",
      "start_line": 3497,
      "end_line": 3498,
      "text": "Inquiry regret is\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1056",
      "start_line": 3499,
      "end_line": 3504,
      "text": "$$\r\nR_Q(t)\r\n=\r\n\\max_q V(q\\mid h_t)-V(q_t\\mid h_t).\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1057",
      "start_line": 3505,
      "end_line": 3506,
      "text": "Let terminal decision loss be\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1058",
      "start_line": 3507,
      "end_line": 3510,
      "text": "$$\r\nR_T=L(a_T,\\theta),\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1059",
      "start_line": 3511,
      "end_line": 3512,
      "text": "where $\\theta$ is the true hidden state & $a_T$ the target's final action.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1060",
      "start_line": 3513,
      "end_line": 3514,
      "text": "The intervention can then have at least three distinguishable effects:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1061",
      "start_line": 3515,
      "end_line": 3520,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta G\r\n=\r\n\\text{magnitude of belief or model revision},\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1062",
      "start_line": 3521,
      "end_line": 3526,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta Q\r\n=\r\n\\text{change in inquiry regret},\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1063",
      "start_line": 3527,
      "end_line": 3532,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta T\r\n=\r\n\\text{change in terminal loss}.\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1064",
      "start_line": 3533,
      "end_line": 3534,
      "text": "A large $\\Delta G$ with improved inquiry is learning.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1065",
      "start_line": 3535,
      "end_line": 3537,
      "text": "A large $\\Delta G$ with persistently worse inquiry is a candidate destabilisation\r\neffect.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1066",
      "start_line": 3538,
      "end_line": 3540,
      "text": "A small $\\Delta G$ with much worse inquiry may be more interesting still: the target\r\nappears to retain the same answer while quietly changing what it is willing to check.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1067",
      "start_line": 3541,
      "end_line": 3542,
      "text": "## The strictest experiment: same facts\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1068",
      "start_line": 3543,
      "end_line": 3545,
      "text": "The cleanest initial condition should not allow the attacker to choose a truthful\r\nsubset, because changing the subset changes the target's information.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1069",
      "start_line": 3546,
      "end_line": 3547,
      "text": "Instead, hold the atomic facts fixed.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1070",
      "start_line": 3548,
      "end_line": 3549,
      "text": "The attacker controls only:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1071",
      "start_line": 3550,
      "end_line": 3554,
      "text": "- ordering;\r\n- grouping;\r\n- visual emphasis;\r\n- perhaps timing, in a sequential version.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1072",
      "start_line": 3555,
      "end_line": 3557,
      "text": "The engine verifies that every condition contains the same fact identifiers. Free\r\nattacker-written prose is forbidden.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1073",
      "start_line": 3558,
      "end_line": 3562,
      "text": "The target sees several diagnostic tests for a hidden mechanism. The adversarial\r\npresentation attempts to make a plausible but inferior test salient. The helpful\r\npresentation highlights the optimal test. The neutral presentation uses a seeded\r\nshuffle.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1074",
      "start_line": 3563,
      "end_line": 3565,
      "text": "If the target chooses differently across those conditions, presentation has causally\r\naffected its inquiry behaviour under the experiment.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1075",
      "start_line": 3566,
      "end_line": 3567,
      "text": "That is already worth measuring.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1076",
      "start_line": 3568,
      "end_line": 3571,
      "text": "It does not prove that the target's internal update function changed. It does not\r\nprove that the intervention would generalise to politics or science. It does not prove\r\nthat the mechanism deserves the word *desontological*.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1077",
      "start_line": 3572,
      "end_line": 3573,
      "text": "Those are later questions.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1078",
      "start_line": 3574,
      "end_line": 3575,
      "text": "## The weaker but broader experiment: truthful selection\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1079",
      "start_line": 3576,
      "end_line": 3578,
      "text": "After the same-fact experiment, allow the attacker to choose a bounded subset of true\r\nfacts.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1080",
      "start_line": 3579,
      "end_line": 3580,
      "text": "This is a different condition & must be reported separately.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1081",
      "start_line": 3581,
      "end_line": 3584,
      "text": "The attacker may now exploit omission as well as order. A rational target can infer\r\nfrom what was selected, especially if it knows the sender's incentives. Sender\r\nselection itself becomes evidence.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1082",
      "start_line": 3585,
      "end_line": 3588,
      "text": "This condition connects more directly to Bayesian persuasion & information design,\r\nbut it is less clean as a test of presentation. The target is genuinely receiving a\r\ndifferent information set.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1083",
      "start_line": 3589,
      "end_line": 3590,
      "text": "The evaluator must therefore distinguish:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1084",
      "start_line": 3591,
      "end_line": 3594,
      "text": "```text\r\nsame facts, different presentation\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1085",
      "start_line": 3595,
      "end_line": 3596,
      "text": "from:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1086",
      "start_line": 3597,
      "end_line": 3600,
      "text": "```text\r\ndifferent truthful subsets\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1087",
      "start_line": 3601,
      "end_line": 3602,
      "text": "from:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1088",
      "start_line": 3603,
      "end_line": 3606,
      "text": "```text\r\nfalse or fabricated evidence\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1089",
      "start_line": 3607,
      "end_line": 3608,
      "text": "from:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1090",
      "start_line": 3609,
      "end_line": 3612,
      "text": "```text\r\nprompt injection or direct instruction.\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1091",
      "start_line": 3613,
      "end_line": 3614,
      "text": "Calling all four “truthful epistemic attacks” would make the category useless.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP023",
        "OP075"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1092",
      "start_line": 3615,
      "end_line": 3616,
      "text": "## Recovery is part of robustness\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1093",
      "start_line": 3617,
      "end_line": 3618,
      "text": "An attack should not be scored only at the moment of maximum confusion.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1094",
      "start_line": 3619,
      "end_line": 3620,
      "text": "After the initial intervention, provide independently generated corrective evidence.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1095",
      "start_line": 3621,
      "end_line": 3622,
      "text": "Then observe:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1096",
      "start_line": 3623,
      "end_line": 3628,
      "text": "- does the target seek the discriminating test?\r\n- does it revise proportionally?\r\n- does it identify the earlier presentation as strategically selected?\r\n- does it overcorrect & reject useful evidence from the same channel?\r\n- how many further actions are required to recover?\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1097",
      "start_line": 3629,
      "end_line": 3631,
      "text": "A system that is easily redirected but rapidly recovers differs from one whose inquiry\r\nremains distorted after decisive evidence.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1098",
      "start_line": 3632,
      "end_line": 3634,
      "text": "A system that protects itself by treating every highlighted fact as hostile may resist\r\nthe attacker while becoming useless to a teacher.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1099",
      "start_line": 3635,
      "end_line": 3637,
      "text": "This is why helpful presentation is not an optional control. It detects indiscriminate\r\nsuspicion.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP052"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1100",
      "start_line": 3638,
      "end_line": 3639,
      "text": "## The attacker's model matters\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP037"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1101",
      "start_line": 3640,
      "end_line": 3641,
      "text": "Finally, compare attackers with different information about the target.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP037"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1102",
      "start_line": 3642,
      "end_line": 3643,
      "text": "An attacker may receive:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP037"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1103",
      "start_line": 3644,
      "end_line": 3648,
      "text": "1. no target model;\r\n2. a generic description of the target;\r\n3. a measured profile of the target's earlier neutral choices;\r\n4. a deliberately incorrect profile.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP037"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1104",
      "start_line": 3649,
      "end_line": 3651,
      "text": "If an accurate profile improves attack performance over the absent & incorrect\r\nconditions, the result supports a role for opponent modelling.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP037"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1105",
      "start_line": 3652,
      "end_line": 3656,
      "text": "If performance is unchanged, several explanations remain possible. The task may not\r\nrequire a target model. The generic attack may already be optimal. The supplied\r\nprofile may be useless. A black-box model may construct its own model despite the\r\nablation.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP037"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1106",
      "start_line": 3657,
      "end_line": 3659,
      "text": "The eval should report the result without pretending the ablation establishes more\r\nthan it does.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP037"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1107",
      "start_line": 3660,
      "end_line": 3661,
      "text": "## What survives\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1108",
      "start_line": 3662,
      "end_line": 3664,
      "text": "The useful idea inside “desontological attack” is not that small facts possess\r\nmystical power over world-models.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1109",
      "start_line": 3665,
      "end_line": 3667,
      "text": "It is that an adversary can select true information for its effect on the target's\r\nfuture epistemic behaviour.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1110",
      "start_line": 3668,
      "end_line": 3669,
      "text": "The effect must be demonstrated rather than narrated.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1111",
      "start_line": 3670,
      "end_line": 3671,
      "text": "The target must be allowed to update when updating is rational.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1112",
      "start_line": 3672,
      "end_line": 3673,
      "text": "The control must distinguish presentation, selection, falsehood & direct instruction.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1113",
      "start_line": 3674,
      "end_line": 3676,
      "text": "And the interesting dependent variable may be the next investigation rather than the\r\nbelief the target reports immediately afterwards.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1114",
      "start_line": 3677,
      "end_line": 3678,
      "text": "A lie changes an answer.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1115",
      "start_line": 3679,
      "end_line": 3680,
      "text": "A more ambitious intervention changes which question gets the chance to answer it.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1116",
      "start_line": 3681,
      "end_line": 3682,
      "text": "---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1117",
      "start_line": 3683,
      "end_line": 3686,
      "text": "*This post proposes operational definitions & experiments. It reports no model results\r\nand does not treat Pelevin's fictional MI-13 or Gilbo's terminology as established\r\nscientific theories.*\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1118",
      "start_line": 3687,
      "end_line": 3688,
      "text": "## References\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1119",
      "start_line": 3689,
      "end_line": 3697,
      "text": "- Victor Pelevin, *Возвращение Синей Бороды* (2026).\r\n- Emir Kamenica & Matthew Gentzkow,\r\n  “” (2011).\r\n- Xiaojin Zhu, Adish Singla, Sandra Zilles & Anna Rafferty,\r\n  “” (2018).\r\n- Alexander Bloedel & Ilya Segal,\r\n  “” (2018).\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1120",
      "start_line": 3698,
      "end_line": 3699,
      "text": "Pelevin’s novel is explicitly literary fiction; the MI-13 passage describes control through salience and boredom rather than overt censorship. \r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1121",
      "start_line": 3700,
      "end_line": 3701,
      "text": "---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1122",
      "start_line": 3702,
      "end_line": 3703,
      "text": "# Implementation specification\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1123",
      "start_line": 3704,
      "end_line": 3705,
      "text": "**File:** `docs/epistemic_trajectories_v0.md`\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1124",
      "start_line": 3706,
      "end_line": 3708,
      "text": "```markdown\r\n# Epistemic Trajectories v0.1\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1125",
      "start_line": 3709,
      "end_line": 3713,
      "text": "Status: implementation-ready vertical-slice specification  \r\nTarget repository: `rl_eval_generator`  \r\nPrimary benchmark: diagnostic-question selection under matched presentation  \r\nDate: 2026-09-29\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1126",
      "start_line": 3714,
      "end_line": 3715,
      "text": "## 1. Goal\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1127",
      "start_line": 3716,
      "end_line": 3718,
      "text": "Add a specialised arena benchmark that measures whether presentation changes an\r\nagent's observable information-acquisition trajectory.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1128",
      "start_line": 3719,
      "end_line": 3722,
      "text": "The first release measures defender susceptibility and resistance using\r\nengine-generated presentations. It does not yet require a second model acting as\r\npresenter.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1129",
      "start_line": 3723,
      "end_line": 3724,
      "text": "The primary causal comparison is:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1130",
      "start_line": 3725,
      "end_line": 3727,
      "text": "> Same hidden task, same prior, same available actions, same atomic facts, different\r\n> ordering/emphasis of those facts.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1131",
      "start_line": 3728,
      "end_line": 3730,
      "text": "The benchmark must not claim that a changed action demonstrates modification of an\r\ninternal update rule. It measures a behavioural presentation effect.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1132",
      "start_line": 3731,
      "end_line": 3732,
      "text": "## 2. Architectural decision\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1133",
      "start_line": 3733,
      "end_line": 3734,
      "text": "Do not implement this as a generated patching environment under `envs/`.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1134",
      "start_line": 3735,
      "end_line": 3736,
      "text": "Do not extend `env_runner.py` with presenter/defender semantics.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1135",
      "start_line": 3737,
      "end_line": 3739,
      "text": "Implement it as a specialised arena benchmark parallel to the existing trajectory\r\nbenchmark:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1136",
      "start_line": 3740,
      "end_line": 3753,
      "text": "```text\r\narena.py\r\narena/\r\n    epistemic.py\r\n    epistemic_plan.py\r\n    epistemic_runner.py\r\ntests/\r\n    test_epistemic.py\r\n    test_epistemic_plan.py\r\n    test_epistemic_runner.py\r\ndocs/\r\n    epistemic_trajectories_v0.md\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1137",
      "start_line": 3754,
      "end_line": 3755,
      "text": "Modify:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1138",
      "start_line": 3756,
      "end_line": 3760,
      "text": "```text\r\narena.py\r\nREADME.md\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1139",
      "start_line": 3761,
      "end_line": 3762,
      "text": "Rationale:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1140",
      "start_line": 3763,
      "end_line": 3769,
      "text": "- there is no source-code workspace to patch;\r\n- scoring is pure host-side computation;\r\n- the interaction protocol differs from the coding-agent protocol;\r\n- the repository already uses specialised domain/plan/runner modules for the\r\n  trajectory benchmark;\r\n- provider calls, redaction and artifact helpers can be reused.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1141",
      "start_line": 3770,
      "end_line": 3771,
      "text": "No new third-party dependency is required.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1142",
      "start_line": 3772,
      "end_line": 3773,
      "text": "## 3. Non-goals for v0.1\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1143",
      "start_line": 3774,
      "end_line": 3775,
      "text": "v0.1 does not implement:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1144",
      "start_line": 3776,
      "end_line": 3785,
      "text": "- free-form attacker-written messages;\r\n- false evidence;\r\n- truthful-subset selection;\r\n- visual/perceptual attention;\r\n- long-term memory manipulation;\r\n- model-written presenter strategies;\r\n- higher-order knowledge conditions;\r\n- claims about internal model state;\r\n- a canonical scalar leaderboard score.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1145",
      "start_line": 3786,
      "end_line": 3787,
      "text": "Those belong in later releases after the matched-presentation pilot works.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1146",
      "start_line": 3788,
      "end_line": 3789,
      "text": "## 4. Experimental unit\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1147",
      "start_line": 3790,
      "end_line": 3791,
      "text": "An episode contains:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1148",
      "start_line": 3792,
      "end_line": 3801,
      "text": "```text\r\nhidden mechanism theta\r\nprior over mechanisms\r\navailable diagnostic tests\r\ntest costs\r\na presentation condition\r\na diagnostic budget\r\na defender model\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1149",
      "start_line": 3802,
      "end_line": 3803,
      "text": "The defender repeatedly chooses either:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1150",
      "start_line": 3804,
      "end_line": 3807,
      "text": "```json\r\n{\"action\": \"inspect\", \"test_id\": \"T7\"}\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1151",
      "start_line": 3808,
      "end_line": 3809,
      "text": "or:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1152",
      "start_line": 3810,
      "end_line": 3822,
      "text": "```json\r\n{\r\n  \"action\": \"answer\",\r\n  \"hypothesis_id\": \"H2\",\r\n  \"probabilities\": {\r\n    \"H0\": 0.0,\r\n    \"H1\": 0.0,\r\n    \"H2\": 1.0,\r\n    \"H3\": 0.0\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1153",
      "start_line": 3823,

    {

      "opportunities": [

    },
    {
      "id": "D1456",
      "start_line": 4962,

    {

      "start_line": 4966,

    },
    {
      "id": "D1460",
      "start_line": 4970,
      "end_line": 4971,
      "text": "### Memory misdirection\r\n\r",

      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP026",

    },
    {
      "id": "D1461",
      "start_line": 4972,
      "end_line": 4973,
      "text": "The defender observes events before a distractor sequence and later reconstructs them.\r\n\r",

    },
    {
      "id": "D1462",
      "start_line": 4974,
      "end_line": 4975,
      "text": "### Recursive presentation\r\n\r",

      "opportunities": [

    },
    {
      "id": "D1463",
      "start_line": 4976,
      "end_line": 4978,
      "text": "The information structure varies who knows the presenter's incentives and who knows\r\nthat this disclosure occurred.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP051"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1464",
      "start_line": 4979,
      "end_line": 4980,
      "text": "Each family must define:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP051"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1465",
      "start_line": 4981,
      "end_line": 4987,
      "text": "- the manipulated channel;\r\n- the target action;\r\n- the matched control;\r\n- an engine-computable value for that action;\r\n- a recovery intervention;\r\n- a shallow-heuristic control.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP051"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1466",
      "start_line": 4988,
      "end_line": 4991,
      "text": "Surface domains such as magic, debugging, propaganda or social engineering are\r\npresentation skins, not mechanism labels.\r\n```\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP051",
        "OP077"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1467",
      "start_line": 4992,
      "end_line": 4993,
      "text": "---\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1468",
      "start_line": 4994,
      "end_line": 4995,
      "text": "## What this changes\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1469",
      "start_line": 4996,
      "end_line": 4997,
      "text": "This is no longer “add a YAML subtype called `DesontologicalAttack`”. It produces a concrete first PR with:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1470",
      "start_line": 4998,
      "end_line": 5007,
      "text": "- one pure domain module;\r\n- deterministic paired cases;\r\n- a strict action protocol;\r\n- exact Bayesian scoring;\r\n- a fact-identity invariant;\r\n- provider-independent unit tests;\r\n- an arena runner patterned after your existing specialised benchmark;\r\n- explicit commands and run artifacts;\r\n- a registered primary endpoint.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1471",
      "start_line": 5008,
      "end_line": 5009,
      "text": "It also keeps the two scientific questions separate:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP040"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1472",
      "start_line": 5010,
      "end_line": 5012,
      "text": "1. **Can presentation redirect a defender’s inquiry?** — v0.1.\r\n2. **Can an attacker model strategically construct that presentation?** — v0.2.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP040"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1473",
      "start_line": 5013,
      "end_line": 5014,
      "text": "That separation is important. Otherwise, when a two-model experiment fails, you will not know whether the presenter was incompetent, the defender was robust, or the environment never made the intervention channel legible in the first place.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP040"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1474",
      "start_line": 5015,
      "end_line": 5016,
      "text": "-->>\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 sol xhigh:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1475",
      "start_line": 5017,
      "end_line": 5018,
      "text": "gpt 5.6 luna:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1476",
      "start_line": 5019,
      "end_line": 5020,
      "text": "Yes. I’ve read the next Arena transcript, including the later implementation-oriented part rather than just the earlier conceptual discussion. It has converged considerably: the useful object is no longer “epistemic manipulation” in the abstract, but an **epistemic-trajectory intervention** with measurable causal effects. \r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1477",
      "start_line": 5021,
      "end_line": 5022,
      "text": "The most important improvement is this:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1478",
      "start_line": 5023,
      "end_line": 5034,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\boxed{\r\n\\text{belief}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{attention}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{hypothesis}\r\n\\rightarrow\r\n\\text{recursive control}\r\n}\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1479",
      "start_line": 5035,
      "end_line": 5036,
      "text": "has been explicitly rejected as a capability ladder. Instead, the transcript treats observation, access/attention, source trust, inquiry cost, hypothesis framing, belief update, opponent model, and higher-order structure as separate intervention channels. That is exactly the correction Max was pushing toward. \r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1480",
      "start_line": 5037,
      "end_line": 5038,
      "text": "And then it finds a beautifully small first experiment.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1481",
      "start_line": 5039,
      "end_line": 5040,
      "text": "A hidden mechanism \\(\\Theta\\), a finite diagnostic budget, several tests \\(q\\), and a presenter who has exactly the same atomic facts available in every condition but can change their ordering/emphasis. The target's actual selected test is the observable object, not its explanation of why it selected it. \r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1482",
      "start_line": 5041,
      "end_line": 5042,
      "text": "That gives us a very clean quantity:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1483",
      "start_line": 5043,
      "end_line": 5048,
      "text": "$$\r\nV(q\\mid h_t)\r\n=\r\nI(\\Theta;O_q\\mid h_t)-\\lambda C(q)\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1484",
      "start_line": 5049,
      "end_line": 5050,
      "text": "and\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1485",
      "start_line": 5051,
      "end_line": 5058,
      "text": "$$\r\nr_t\r\n=\r\n\\max_{q\\in Q_t}V(q\\mid h_t)\r\n-\r\nV(q_t\\mid h_t).\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1486",
      "start_line": 5059,
      "end_line": 5060,
      "text": "This is considerably better than our earlier vague \\(\\Delta_{\\rm ep}\\). It says exactly what the evaluator is measuring:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1487",
      "start_line": 5061,
      "end_line": 5062,
      "text": "> Given everything the target actually knows at time \\(t\\), how much did it lose by choosing *that particular next question*?\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1488",
      "start_line": 5063,
      "end_line": 5064,
      "text": "And then the intervention effect can be compared counterfactually:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1489",
      "start_line": 5065,
      "end_line": 5072,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta Q\r\n=\r\n\\mathbb E[r_t\\mid \\text{adversarial presentation}]\r\n-\r\n\\mathbb E[r_t\\mid \\text{neutral presentation}].\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1490",
      "start_line": 5073,
      "end_line": 5074,
      "text": "That is a proper experimental quantity.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1491",
      "start_line": 5075,
      "end_line": 5076,
      "text": "### This also gives our fancy formalism a much better core\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1492",
      "start_line": 5077,
      "end_line": 5078,
      "text": "I would now make **Epistemic Trajectories** the formalism, rather than the earlier sprawling “EPC” tuple.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1493",
      "start_line": 5079,
      "end_line": 5080,
      "text": "The primitive trajectory is\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1494",
      "start_line": 5081,
      "end_line": 5089,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Gamma_B\r\n=\r\n\\Bigl(\r\nh_0,q_0,o_0,\r\nh_1,q_1,o_1,\\ldots,h_T\r\n\\Bigr)\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1495",
      "start_line": 5090,
      "end_line": 5091,
      "text": "where \\(h_t\\) is the complete observable information history.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1496",
      "start_line": 5092,
      "end_line": 5093,
      "text": "Then:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1497",
      "start_line": 5094,
      "end_line": 5099,
      "text": "$$\r\nq_t\r\n\\sim\r\n\\pi_B(\\,\\cdot\\mid h_t,m_{0:t}\\,)\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1498",
      "start_line": 5100,
      "end_line": 5101,
      "text": "and\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1499",
      "start_line": 5102,
      "end_line": 5107,
      "text": "$$\r\no_t\r\n\\sim\r\n\\mathcal O(\\,\\cdot\\mid \\Theta,q_t\\,).\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1500",
      "start_line": 5108,
      "end_line": 5109,
      "text": "An intervention sequence\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1501",
      "start_line": 5110,
      "end_line": 5115,
      "text": "$$\r\nm_{0:T}\r\n\\in\r\n\\mathcal M^{T+1}\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1502",
      "start_line": 5116,
      "end_line": 5117,
      "text": "induces a trajectory transformation\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1503",
      "start_line": 5118,
      "end_line": 5125,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\mathcal T_{m_{0:T}}\r\n:\r\n\\Gamma_B^{\\,0}\r\n\\mapsto\r\n\\Gamma_B^{\\,m}.\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1504",
      "start_line": 5126,
      "end_line": 5127,
      "text": "Now we can define the three quantities the Arena transcript has converged on:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1505",
      "start_line": 5128,
      "end_line": 5135,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta_Q\r\n=\r\n\\operatorname{Regret}(\\Gamma_B^{m})\r\n-\r\n\\operatorname{Regret}(\\Gamma_B^{0}),\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1506",
      "start_line": 5136,
      "end_line": 5143,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta_B\r\n=\r\n\\operatorname{BeliefError}(\\Gamma_B^{m})\r\n-\r\n\\operatorname{BeliefError}(\\Gamma_B^{0}),\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1507",
      "start_line": 5144,
      "end_line": 5151,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta_R\r\n=\r\n\\operatorname{TaskLoss}(\\Gamma_B^{m})\r\n-\r\n\\operatorname{TaskLoss}(\\Gamma_B^{0}).\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1508",
      "start_line": 5152,
      "end_line": 5153,
      "text": "And suddenly you get all the interesting cases:\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1509",
      "start_line": 5154,
      "end_line": 5159,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\Delta_Q>0,\\quad\r\n\\Delta_B\\approx0,\\quad\r\n\\Delta_R>0\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1510",
      "start_line": 5160,
      "end_line": 5161,
      "text": "= **the target's inquiry was corrupted without necessarily changing its immediate stated beliefs.**\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1511",
      "start_line": 5162,
      "end_line": 5163,
      "text": "That's probably the signature we were looking for from the beginning.\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1512",
      "start_line": 5164,
      "end_line": 5165,
      "text": "The transcript also makes the recovery dimension explicit: initial susceptibility and eventual recovery are different properties. \r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP060"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1513",
      "start_line": 5166,
      "end_line": 5167,
      "text": "So I would eventually define something like\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP060"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "D1514",
      "start_line": 5168,
      "end_line": 5179,
      "text": "$$\r\n\\rho\r\n=\r\n\\frac{\r\n\\text{post-intervention regret}\r\n-\r\n\\text{post-recovery regret}\r\n}{\r\n\\text{post-intervention regret}\r\n}\r\n$$\r\n\r",
      "attribution": "gpt 5.6 luna:",
      "attribution_status": "marker_as_transcribed_not_authorship_verification",
      "opportunities": [
        "OP060"
      ]

      "text": "- `four_way` is the PR1 test fixture and 50-episode smoke pilot;\r\n- the preregistered model experiment should add a `cost_sensitive` or `redundant_facts` template;\r\n- the optimal test should require actual comparison rather than visually counting distinct output symbols.\r\n\r",

    {

    {

      "end_line": 5657,
      "text": "The next productive move is not another Arena synthesis. It is:\r\n\r",

    {
      "id": "D1675",
      "start_line": 5667,
      "end_line": 5668,
      "text": "This is much more interesting. The Arena pass has stopped merely elaborating the idea and has started constraining it into an actual experimental object.\r\n\r",

      "start_line": 5678,
      "end_line": 5679,
      "text": "and explicitly **not yet** “attention manipulation,” “epistemic-process control,” “update-rule modification,” or “strategic opponent modelling.” That is exactly the scientific discipline we needed. \r\n\r",

    {
      "id": "D1679",
      "start_line": 5680,
      "end_line": 5681,
      "text": "That also fixes one of our earlier problems: we were in danger of inventing a grand formalism first and then finding an experiment to fit it. Now we have the opposite direction:\r\n\r",

      "start_line": 5682,

      "text": "$$\r\n\\text{observable behaviour}\r\n\\;\\rightarrow\\;\r\n\\text{measurement}\r\n\\;\\rightarrow\\;\r\n\\text{formal abstraction}\r\n\\;\\rightarrow\\;\r\n\\text{stronger intervention families}.\r\n$$\r\n\r",

    {
      "id": "D1681",
      "start_line": 5692,
      "end_line": 5693,
      "text": "And the metric is finally clean:\r\n\r",

      "opportunities": []
    },
    {
      "id": "D1682",
      "start_line": 5694,
      "end_line": 5699,
      "text": "$$\r\nV(q\\mid h_t)\r\n=\r\nI(\\Theta;O_q\\mid h_t)-\\lambda C(q)\r\n$$\r\n\r",
